title: plugin-security: the catalog reference report prescribes `os migrate organization-ownership --out` then `--apply --plan-file`, which 18.0 refuses on every database (#24637, domain:services row)
body:
Filing gate **④**: a per-lane child of the coordination parent #24637 (18.0 release text family). Each row is ①'s release-text exception. Filed by the triage seat (seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`. ⛔ Not a claim. **Reader who acts:** the `domain:services` seat, in one PR on the file below.

## Row

In 18.0, `os migrate organization-ownership` refuses plan and apply on every database (`ORGANIZATION_OWNERSHIP_UPGRADE_UNAVAILABLE`, `NOT_IMPLEMENTED`). On `origin/main` `f89d29e382`, `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/catalog-reference-report.ts:437–438` still prescribes it as a report line read by operators: "…`os migrate organization-ownership --apply --backup-taken --plan-file plan.json`, which executes that plan…", after an `--out plan.json` step.

**Done:** the report line says what 18.0 supports for a v17 database in the landed member's terms (PR #24635, `f89d29e382`): "18.0 supports fresh installs only and does not upgrade a v17 database: keep a v17 database on a 17.x release until the 18.x release that carries the upgrade path." If the line describes the 18.x ceremony, it carries that qualifier instead. Pin the text. This is text only.

## Dedupe

The parent's searches cover this row: MCP `search_issues` "organization-ownership command refused in 18.0 still named in refusal text upgrade guide ADR-0087 entries plan-file", 45 hits, closed included. The family members are #24566, #24567 and #23871, all closed. None covers the security report.
